jobs.title: Implementation Specialist
jobs.description: Metaview is an AI company focused on recruiting. We build AI agents that help world-class companies hire with radically more speed and precision. We automate the toil, and augment the human for companies like Brex, Affirm, Deel, ElevenLabs, and Airtable. Founded by Siadhal and Shahriar after their experiences scaling Uber and Palantir, we’ve raised $110m from top-tier investors including Google Ventures and Insight Partners. It’s still day 0: Now is the time to re-engineer how work gets done with AI at the core, and our toughest challenges still lie ahead. We’re looking for people seeking the hardest, most fulfilling work of their lives. How we work: Four principles guide us: Velocity. Optimize for rate of learning. Take action, get feedback, get better. Hospitality. Sweat the experience. Delight customers, candidates and colleagues, even when it’s inconvenient. Transparency. Public unless private. Share context openly within the company so people and agents can take initiative. End-to-end. Deliver outcomes, not tasks. Step beyond your job description and see the work through. The role: We're hiring our first Implementation Specialist to own how our customers first experience the product. You'll take new customers from signature to steady state: handle the configuration, run the training, and get every user live and productive across the Metaview agents that they’ve chosen to get started with. A great implementation sets the whole relationship up for success. Done well, every end user sees value fast and the customer sees clear ROI against their own success criteria. This is a brand new role, and there's a ton of room to define what great looks like as we build out the function. It's also one of the most hands-on seats in the company for learning how AI actually gets adopted inside a business. jobs.title: Elektronik-Ingenieur
jobs.description: About pplwise pplwise is a recruiting consultancy for fast-growing technology companies across Europe. Through Recruiting as a Service and Executive Search, we fill key roles for our clients, from start-ups to publicly listed companies. We are filling this position for our client Filics. About our client: Filics Filics is reinventing intralogistics with autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) that change how material moves. Its double-runner system makes Filics the first and only AMR that can drive through load carriers such as Euro pallets. This breaks with forklift logic and sets a new standard for efficiency. Filics is a small, hands-on team that solves hard problems with engineering excellence. Leadership goes to those who take initiative and consistently deliver. As Senior Electrical Engineer (m/f/d) at Filics, you will design the electronics at the core of the next generation of robots. About the role This is an on-site/hybrid role in Munich, close to engineering and assembly. Filics doesn’t just use off-the-shelf components. It builds its own custom IP. The robots run on advanced boards that cover a wide range of electrical engineering. On one end is high power, such as battery and motor controllers. On the other end are high-speed interfaces like PCIe, USB and MIPI CSI. The real challenge is making all these subsystems work together as one system. Many of these problems have no textbook solution. Solving them takes solid experience, a deep understanding of the physics and a creative mind. The EE team is small, and the robot is far from finished. You’ll own your boards end to end : requirements, system design, schematic, layout, design review, sourcing, manufacturing, testing and validation. You’ll keep owning them for as long as they’re in production. You’ll work closely with Embedded Software, Mechanical Engineering, Software and the Production team. As Filics moves from prototypes to series production, your designs need to work reliably at scale , not just in the
